u_B}\) for tall \(
u\) and \(0\) for wide \(
u\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 326-341]

The proof of Lemma 2.5 adds no restriction beyond its stated valid-tuple and syzygy hypotheses: it obtains consistency by deleting equations from the larger system. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 342-344]
